prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Kobie
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3-5 years of experience in solutions architecture, business requirements ana

assessments.note: 4+ years as Systems Architect satisfies experience range.
No evidence of creating BRDs, SCDs, or feature briefs.
Data validation experience present but not cost estimate validation.
No mention of Agile, Scrum, or waterfall methodologies.
Integrated solutions shown; coordination across teams not explicit.
Risk mitigation via validation pipelines, but scope drift handling not shown.
No delivery experience in specified industries.
CRM integration shown; specific MarTech platform familiarity unclear.

output.verdict_line: Candidate meets core architecture experience but lacks several key documentation, methodology, and domain requirements.
